rationale: The side-door sensor (door_side) reports a battery level of 6%, below the threshold at which SEN-D1 sensors go offline and miss events. Its RSSI is healthy (-62 dBm) and it remains correctly bound in both the base station and app, ruling out misalignment or binding issues. The log line "door_side battery level 6%" confirms the low-battery condition.

repair_steps: Instruct the customer to replace the battery in the side-door sensor (SEN-D1) with a fresh CR123A lithium battery.
After replacement, ask the customer to open and close the side door to verify the sensor triggers and the app shows it online.
Confirm in the app that the side-door sensor status changes to online and no further offline alerts occur.
output.customer_reply: Thanks for your patience. We found the side-door sensor's battery is critically low (6%), which causes it to go offline and miss events. The sensor is properly aligned and connected, so no need to adjust it. Please replace the battery with a fresh CR123A lithium battery. After that, test the door and check the app; it should show online and stop sending alerts. Let us know if you need further help.

results.text: CAM-S1 runs on a rechargeable battery lasting 3 to 6 months. Below 10 percent the camera disables live view and may miss events; below 3 percent it goes offline. Charge with the supplied USB-C cable for about 6 hours. Frequent motion events in busy areas shorten battery life; enable power-saving mode.

Uplink loss of the base station, pairing timeouts, capacity limit reached, weak signal of a single device, low battery, outdated peripheral firmware that upgrades successfully via OTA, and full storage. Provide the customer with step-by-step instructions and confirm the issue is resolved.

results.source: historical_cases#H-05 Three sensors offline at once
results.text: Three sensors in different rooms went offline at the same minute; base station online, RSSI history normal, E-610 in log. Restarting did not help. Escalated; radio module replaced. Escalated correctly.

complaint: The side-door sensor shows offline and the app sends me an alert every few hours. I opened the door to test it and nothing happened. We had the house repainted last week and the painter may have bumped the sensor, so I think it is misaligned. I haven't touched it since.
